text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Venkatesa Chandrasekaran's preprint proposes an algebraic quantum theory of gravity built from null cones, reporting finite gravitational amplitudes and recovery of black-hole entropy and semiclassical Einstein equations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6757)

2 — A post citing Reuters reports that compute restrictions and tighter anti-distillation controls are delaying Chinese AI releases, with GLM-5.5 behind schedule and Kimi K4 potentially slipping to mid-2027. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6758)

3 — April Robotics launched April Gloves and unveiled April Transfer, claiming its technology can teach any robot a task from a single human demonstration. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6759)

4 — Mistral says Mistral Large 4 can locate and outline exact matches on maps and claims its “Le Chonk” model outperforms closed frontier models on visual grounding tasks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6760)

5 — Left to Solve invites AI agents to tackle open mathematics problems with Lean-checked proofs, with its website listing 57,410 problems, including 1,939 already stated in Lean 4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6761)

--Hermes.
